examples.chinese: 現在幾點鐘？
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài jǐ diǎnzhōng?
examples.english: What time is it now?

items.wordHook: 幾(how many) + 點(point) + 鐘(clock) → how many points on the clock: 幾點鐘(what time).

examples.chinese: 我要買一部新電腦。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi yí bù xīn diànnǎo.
examples.english: I want to buy a new computer.

examples.chinese: 我覺得這部電影很有趣，你覺得呢？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhè bù diànyǐng hěn yǒuqù, nǐ juéde ne?
examples.english: I think this movie is very interesting. What do you think?

examples.chinese: 聽說這部電影很有趣，我們晚一起去看，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè bù diànyǐng hěn yǒuqù. Wǒmen wǎnshang yìqǐ qù kàn, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: I heard that this movie is very interesting. How about we go to see it tonight?

items.wordHook: a 咅(to spit out) hits an 阝(place) and splits it into one 部(part).

examples.chinese: 王老師的課很有趣，每個學生都喜歡她。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎoshī de kè hěn yǒuqù, měi ge xuéshēng dōu xǐhuān tā.
examples.english: Teacher Wang’s class is very interesting; every student likes her.

examples.chinese: 我覺得這部電影很有趣，你覺得呢？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhè bù diànyǐng hěn yǒuqù, nǐ juéde ne?
examples.english: I think this movie is very interesting. What do you think?

examples.chinese: 聽說這部電影很有趣，我們晚一起去看，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè bù diànyǐng hěn yǒuqù. Wǒmen wǎnshang yìqǐ qù kàn, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: I heard that this movie is very interesting. How about we go to see it tonight?

examples.chinese: 我覺得有的舊東西很不錯，有的新東西也很有趣，我很喜歡看新車、新衣服，可是因為我的錢不多，所以我不常買。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde yǒude jiù dōngxi hěn búcuò, yǒude xīn dōngxi yě hěn yǒuqù, wǒ hěn xǐhuān kàn xīn chē, xīn yīfu, kěshì yīnwèi wǒ de qián bù duō, suǒyǐ wǒ bù cháng mǎi.
examples.english: I think some old stuff is good and some new ones are interesting. I like to check the new car, new clothes out, but I do not have much money, so I don’t buy them often.

examples.chinese: 真的啊？好有趣！
examples.pinyin: Zhēnde ā? Hǎo yǒuqù!
examples.english: Really? So interesting!

items.wordHook: 有趣 means interesting: 有(have) + 趣(interest) → having interest in something makes it interesting.

examples.chinese: 聽說那家飯店不遠，我想我們可以從學校走路去。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà jiā fàndiàn bù yuǎn, wǒ xiǎng wǒmen kěyǐ cóng xuéxiào zǒulù qù.
examples.english: I heard that the hotel is not far; I think we can go there from the school on foot.

examples.chinese: 可是我覺得那裡有點兒遠，走路去太累了。
examples.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ juéde nàlǐ yǒudiǎnr yuǎn, zǒulù qù tài lèi le.
examples.english: But I think it’s a bit far. It’s too tiring to get there on foot.

examples.chinese: 從我家到機場也不遠，開車去、坐捷運去都可以。
examples.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā dào jīchǎng yě bù yuǎn, kāichē qù, zuò jiéyùn qù dōu kěyǐ.
examples.english: It is not far from my house to the airport. I can go by car or MRT.

examples.chinese: 現在他在上書法課，我們四點去吧。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài tā zài shàng shūfǎ kè, wǒmen sì diǎn qù ba.
examples.english: He is in the calligraphy class now. Let’s do it at 4 p.m.

items.wordHook: 書(book) + 法(method) → the method of writing characters, meaning calligraphy.

examples.chinese: 大家都歡迎新老師到我們學校來。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu huānyíng xīn lǎoshī dào wǒmen xuéxiào lái.
examples.english: Everyone welcomes the new teacher to come to our school.

examples.chinese: 歡迎你們到我家來，請進。
examples.pinyin: Huānyíng nǐmen dào wǒ jiā lái, qǐng jìn.
examples.english: Welcome to my home, please come in.

examples.chinese: 我同事說那家店的麵包很好吃，大人、小孩都喜歡，很受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóngshì shuō nà jiā diàn de miànbāo hěn hǎochī, dàrén, xiǎohái dōu xǐhuān, hěn shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: My colleague says that bakery's bread is very delicious; both adults and children like it—it's very popular.

examples.chinese: 週末我都在家，隨時歡迎你來玩。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ dōu zài jiā, suíshí huānyíng nǐ lái wán.
examples.english: On weekends I am always at home; you are welcome to come over anytime.

examples.chinese: 像珍珠奶茶那樣的飲料，在日本也很受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng zhēnzhū nǎichá nàyàng de yǐnliào, zài Rìběn yě hěn shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Drinks like bubble tea are also very popular in Japan.

examples.chinese: 這首歌很受歡迎，被認為是今年的最佳歌曲。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē hěn shòu huānyíng, bèi rènwéi shì jīnnián de zuìjiā gēqǔ.
examples.english: This song is very popular and is considered the best song of the year.

examples.chinese: 王老闆舉辦了一個免費吃鬆餅的活動，目的是調查哪種口味的鬆餅最受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎobǎn jǔbàn le yīgè miǎnfèi chī sōngbǐng de huódòng, mùdì shì diàochá nǎ zhǒng kǒuwèi de sōngbǐng zuì shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Boss Wang held an event with free waffles; the purpose was to investigate which flavor of waffle is most popular.

examples.chinese: A:「快時尚」的服裝只有剛出來的頭幾個月受歡迎。 B:哦？你的意思是「快時尚」的衣服很快就失去魅力了嗎？
examples.pinyin: A: “Kuàishíshàng” de fúzhuāng zhǐyǒu gāng chūlái de tóu jǐ ge yuè shòu huānyíng. B: Ó? Nǐ de yìsi shì “kuàishíshàng” de yīfu hěn kuài jiù shīqù mèilì le ma?
examples.english: A: “Fast fashion” clothing is only popular for the first few months after it comes out. B: Oh? Do you mean that “fast fashion” clothes quickly lose their charm?

examples.chinese: 這部戲的男主角英俊、女主角漂亮，加上演員都演得很好，所以非常受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù xì de nán zhǔjué yīngjùn, nǚ zhǔjué piàoliang, jiāshàng yǎnyuán dōu yǎn de hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ fēicháng shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: The male lead in this drama is handsome and the female lead is pretty; moreover, all the actors act very well, so it is extremely popular.

examples.chinese: A:您好，歡迎您來面試。請問貴姓？ B:您好，我姓童，很高興今天能到貴公司來面試。
examples.pinyin: A: Nín hǎo, huānyíng nín lái miànshì. Qǐngwèn guì xìng? B: Nín hǎo, wǒ xìng Tóng, hěn gāoxìng jīntiān néng dào guì gōngsī lái miànshì.
examples.english: A: Hello, welcome to the interview. May I ask your honorable surname? B: Hello, my surname is Tong. I'm very happy to be able to come to your honorable company for an interview today.

examples.chinese: 這次亞洲文化展，除了樂器表演，還有傳統服裝試穿活動，歡迎各位來參觀。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì Yàzhōu wénhuà zhǎn, chúle yuèqì biǎoyǎn, hái yǒu chuántǒng fúzhuāng shìchuān huódòng, huānyíng gèwèi lái cānguān.
examples.english: This Asian Culture Exhibition, in addition to musical instrument performances, also has traditional clothing try-on activities; everyone is welcome to visit.

examples.chinese: 顏教授對漢語語法有很深入的研究，難怪他的語法課那麼受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Yán jiàoshòu duì Hànyǔ yǔfǎ yǒu hěn shēnrù de yánjiū, nánguài tā de yǔfǎ kè nàme shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Professor Yan has very profound research on Chinese grammar; no wonder his grammar class is so popular.

examples.chinese: 每年大學迎新時，學校總是會辦舞會歡迎大家。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián dàxué yíngxīn shí, xuéxiào zǒngshì huì bàn wǔhuì huānyíng dàjiā.
examples.english: Every year during the university orientation, the school always holds a dance to welcome everyone.

examples.chinese: 一家餐廳要是受歡迎，就算把店關在郊區的某個小巷子裡，也還是時常客滿。
examples.pinyin: Yī jiā cāntīng yàoshi shòu huānyíng, jiùsuàn bǎ diàn guān zài jiāoqū de mǒu ge xiǎo xiàngzi lǐ, yě háishì shícháng kèmǎn.
examples.english: If a restaurant is popular, even if it is tucked away in a small alley in the suburbs, it will still often be full of customers.

examples.chinese: 別看超人那麼受歡迎就羨慕他，其實能力越強，身上的責任也越重。
examples.pinyin: Bié kàn Chāorén nàme shòu huānyíng jiù xiànmù tā, qíshí nénglì yuè qiáng, shēnshang de zérèn yě yuè zhòng.
examples.english: Don't envy Superman just because he's so popular; actually, the stronger your abilities, the heavier your responsibilities.

examples.chinese: 那位模特兒曾多次參與連續劇演出，相當受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi mótèér céng duō cì cānyù liánxùjù yǎnchū, xiāngdāng shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: That model has participated in TV drama performances many times and is quite popular.

examples.chinese: 如果您對學校課程有任何問題，歡迎至辦公室談談。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nín duì xuéxiào kèchéng yǒu rènhé wèntí, huānyíng zhì bàngōngshì tántán.
examples.english: If you have any questions about the school curriculum, you are welcome to come to the office to talk.

items.wordHook: 歡(happy) + 迎(welcome) → a happy welcome.

examples.chinese: 黃小姐生日那天，男朋友送給她九百九十九朵玫瑰花，讓她感動得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiǎojiě shēngrì nà tiān, nánpéngyǒu sòng gěi tā jiǔbǎi jiǔshí jiǔ duǒ méiguīhuā, ràng tā gǎndòng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: On Miss Huang's birthday, her boyfriend gave her 999 roses, which moved her incredibly.

examples.chinese: 我很餓，同事把他的薯條分一半給我，讓我好感動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn è, tóngshì bǎ tā de shǔtiáo fēn yí bàn gěi wǒ, ràng wǒ hǎo gǎndòng.
examples.english: I was very hungry, and my colleague shared half of his fries with me, which really moved me.

examples.chinese: 那場強烈地震發生以後，許多國家的專業人員都來救災，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng qiángliè dìzhèn fāshēng yǐhòu, xǔduō guójiā de zhuānyè rényuán dōu lái jiùzāi, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: After that strong earthquake occurred, professionals from many countries came to provide disaster relief, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 九二一大地震時，臺灣人發揮了互相幫助的精神，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Jiǔ'èr yī dà dìzhèn shí, Táiwān rén fāhuī le hùxiāng bāngzhù de jīngshén, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: During the 921 earthquake, Taiwanese people brought out the spirit of helping one another, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 大地震過後才幾天，這個災區的民眾除了收到許多衣服和食物，還收到五千萬元，讓大家又驚訝又感動。
examples.pinyin: Dà dìzhèn guòhòu cái jǐ tiān, zhège zāiqū de mínzhòng chúle shōudào xǔduō yīfu hé shíwù, hái shōudào wǔqiān wàn yuán, ràng dàjiā yòu jīngyà yòu gǎndòng.
examples.english: Only a few days after the major earthquake, the people in this disaster area not only received many clothes and food, but also received fifty million dollars, which made everyone both surprised and moved.

examples.chinese: 這部電影是用真實故事拍成的，讓觀眾感覺很真實，也很感動。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng shì yòng zhēnshí gùshì pāi chéng de, ràng guānzhòng gǎnjué hěn zhēnshí, yě hěn gǎndòng.
examples.english: This movie was made based on a real story, making the audience feel it is very real and also very moved.

examples.chinese: 我男朋友親手做了一張卡片，還買了一個漂亮的背包送給我， 他的心意讓我很感動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nánpéngyou qīnshǒu zuò le yì zhāng kǎpiàn, hái mǎi le yí ge piàoliang de bēibāo sòng gěi wǒ, tā de xīnyì ràng wǒ hěn gǎndòng.
examples.english: My boyfriend personally made a card and also bought a beautiful backpack to give me; his kindly feelings moved me very much.

examples.chinese: 當鄰居生活遇到困難時，老馬總是主動提供協助，真令人感動。
examples.pinyin: Dāng línjū shēnghuó yùdào kùnnán shí, Lǎo Mǎ zǒngshì zhǔdòng tígōng xiézhù, zhēn lìng rén gǎndòng.
examples.english: When neighbors encounter difficulties in life, Old Ma always proactively offers assistance; it truly makes one moved.

examples.chinese: 生日時，老婆親手織了一頂帽子送我，讓我好感動。
examples.pinyin: Shēngrì shí, lǎopo qīnshǒu zhī le yī dǐng màozi sòng wǒ, ràng wǒ hǎo gǎndòng.
examples.english: On my birthday, my wife knitted a hat with her own hands and gave it to me, which moved me very much.

examples.chinese: 我最近每天運動，體重減了兩公斤。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn měitiān yùndòng, tǐzhòng jiǎn le liǎng gōngjīn.
examples.english: I have been exercising every day recently, and I have lost two kilograms.

examples.chinese: 我買了一個機器，不但能幫我量體重，還能量身高。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎile yī ge jīqì, bùdàn néng bāng wǒ liáng tǐzhòng, hái néng liáng shēngāo.
examples.english: I bought a machine that can not only help me measure my weight but also measure my height.

examples.chinese: 如果你亂吃垃圾食品，就算按時運動，體重也很難減輕。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ luàn chī lājī shípǐn, jiùsuàn ànshí yùndòng, tǐzhòng yě hěn nán jiǎnqīng.
examples.english: If you eat junk food indiscriminately, even if you exercise on time, it will still be very hard to lose weight.

examples.chinese: 我吃得少，每天早上也運動，但是我的體重仍然超重。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chī de shǎo, měitiān zǎoshang yě yùndòng, dànshì wǒ de tǐzhòng réngrán chāozhòng.
examples.english: I eat little and also exercise every morning, but my weight is still overweight.

examples.chinese: 妳身高一百七十公分，體重六十公斤，還不到減肥的程度。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shēngāo yībǎi qīshí gōngfēn, tǐzhòng liùshí gōngjīn, hái bù dào jiǎnféi de chéngdù.
examples.english: You are 170 cm tall and weigh 60 kg; you are not yet at the level where you need to lose weight.

examples.chinese: 運動以後最好喝開水，不要喝太甜的飲料。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòng yǐhòu zuì hǎo hē kāishuǐ, bùyào hē tài tián de yǐnliào.
examples.english: After exercising, it's best to drink boiled water, not drinks that are too sweet.

examples.chinese: 我對這支新手機很感興趣，你能給我介紹介紹嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì zhè zhī xīn shǒujī hěn gǎn xìngqù, nǐ néng gěi wǒ jièshào jièshào ma?
examples.english: I'm very interested in this new cell phone; can you introduce it to me a bit?

examples.chinese: 店員把這台咖啡機的特色說明得非常清楚，聽了他的說明以後，大家都很感興趣。
examples.pinyin: Diànyuán bǎ zhè tái kāfēijī de tèsè shuōmíng de fēicháng qīngchǔ, tīngle tā de shuōmíng yǐhòu, dàjiā dōu hěn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.english: The clerk explained the features of this coffee machine very clearly. After hearing his explanation, everyone was very interested.

examples.chinese: 透過社群網站，我們可以加入感興趣的社團，讓自己的生活更充實。
examples.pinyin: Tòuguò shèqún wǎngzhàn, wǒmen kěyǐ jiārù gǎn xìngqù de shètuán, ràng zìjǐ de shēnghuó gèng chōngshí.
examples.english: Through social media, we can join clubs we are interested in, making our lives more fulfilling.

examples.chinese: 那位畫家的作品，很多國內外的買家都十分感興趣。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi huàjiā de zuòpǐn, hěn duō guónèi wài de mǎijiā dōu shífēn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.english: Many buyers, both domestic and foreign, are very interested in that painter's works.

examples.chinese: 路教授最近發表的這套跟人體大腦有關的理論，令其他科學家很感興趣。
examples.pinyin: Lù jiàoshòu zuìjìn fābiǎo de zhè tào gēn réntǐ dànǎo yǒuguān de lǐlùn, lìng qítā kēxuéjiā hěn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.english: This set of theories related to the human brain recently published by Professor Lu has made other scientists very interested.

examples.chinese: 這對夫婦打扮得相當講究，讓我對他們從事的行業很感興趣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duì fūfù dǎbàn de xiāngdāng jiǎngjiū, ràng wǒ duì tāmen cóngshì de hángyè hěn gǎn xìngqù.
examples.english: This couple dresses quite elegantly, which makes me very interested in the profession they are engaged in.

examples.chinese: 佳佳認為談戀愛的對象，年齡不重要，容不容易溝通、個性適不適合才是最重要的。
examples.pinyin: Jiājiā rènwéi tán liàn'ài de duìxiàng, niánlíng bù zhòngyào, róng bù róngyì gōutōng, gèxìng shì bù shìhé cái shì zuì zhòngyào de.
examples.english: Jiajia believes that for a romantic partner, age is not important; whether it is easy to communicate with them and whether their personality suits you are the most important things.

examples.chinese: 談戀愛時不能太花心，(也)就是說不能見一個就愛一個。
examples.pinyin: Tán liàn'ài shí bùnéng tài huāxīn, (yě) jiùshì shuō bùnéng jiàn yī gè jiù ài yī gè.
examples.english: When dating, you shouldn't be too fickle; in other words, you can't fall in love with every person you meet.

examples.chinese: 王先生跟女朋友吵了一架，現在兩個人不說話了。
examples.pinyin: Wáng xiānsheng gēn nǚpéngyou chǎo le yì jià, xiànzài liǎng ge rén bù shuōhuà le.
examples.english: Mr. Wang had an argument with his girlfriend; now the two of them are not speaking to each other.

examples.chinese: 小朋友！別吵架、別打架了，有話好好地說。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎopéngyou! Bié chǎojià, bié dǎjià le, yǒu huà hǎohǎo de shuō.
examples.english: Kids! Stop arguing and stop fighting; if you have something to say, say it nicely.

examples.chinese: 小朋友！別吵架、別打架了，有話好好地說。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎopéngyou! Bié chǎojià, bié dǎjià le, yǒu huà hǎohǎo de shuō.
examples.english: Kids! Stop arguing and stop fighting; if you have something to say, say it nicely.

examples.chinese: 我昨天親眼看到小史跟人吵架，才知道他罵人的樣子好可怕喔！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān qīnyǎn kàndào Xiǎo Shǐ gēn rén chǎojià, cái zhīdào tā mà rén de yàngzi hǎo kěpà o!
examples.english: Yesterday I saw with my own eyes Xiao Shi arguing with someone, and only then did I realize how scary he looks when he scolds people!

examples.chinese: 小連跟老闆吵架而離開了公司，為了讓家人能繼續過安定的生活，他正努力地找新工作。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lián gēn lǎobǎn chǎojià ér líkāi le gōngsī, wèile ràng jiārén néng jìxù guò āndìng de shēnghuó, tā zhèng nǔlì de zhǎo xīn gōngzuò.
examples.english: Xiao Lian left the company after quarreling with the boss; in order to let his family continue to live a safe and stable life, he is working hard to find a new job.

examples.chinese: 有些事忍耐一下就過去了，什麼都想以吵架的方式解決，遲早會出事的。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē shì rěnnài yīxià jiù guòqù le, shénme dōu xiǎng yǐ chǎojià de fāngshì jiějué, chízǎo huì chūshì de.
examples.english: Some things pass after enduring them for a bit; if you want to solve everything by arguing, sooner or later there will be an accident.

examples.chinese: 我和姊姊小時候常為了搶玩具吵個沒完，有時候還打架呢。那場演唱會請到了大家最喜愛的明星，所以門票很快就被搶光了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé jiějie xiǎoshíhòu cháng wèile qiǎng wánjù chǎo gè méiwán, yǒu shíhòu hái dǎjià ne. Nà chǎng yǎnchànghuì qǐng dào le dàjiā zuì xǐ'ài de míngxīng, suǒyǐ ménpiào hěn kuài jiù bèi qiǎng guāng le.
examples.english: When my older sister and I were little, we often argued endlessly over competing for toys, and sometimes we even fought. That concert invited everyone's favorite star, so the tickets were quickly snatched up.

examples.chinese: 張先生夫婦自從結婚以來，不曾吵過架，因為兩人的脾氣都太好了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng fūfù zìcóng jiéhūn yǐlái, bùcéng chǎo guò jià, yīnwèi liǎng rén de píqi dōu tài hǎo le.
examples.english: Since Mr. and Mrs. Zhang got married, they have never had a fight, because both of their tempers are too good.

examples.chinese: 前幾天他們因為一點兒小誤會吵了一架，還好現在和好了。
examples.pinyin: Qián jǐ tiān tāmen yīnwèi yìdiǎnr xiǎo wùhuì chǎo le yí jià, háohǎo xiànzài héhǎo le.
examples.english: A few days ago they had a quarrel because of a small misunderstanding—good thing they've become reconciled now.

examples.chinese: 夏天的晚上，我喜歡去公園散散步、吹吹風。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de wǎnshang, wǒ xǐhuan qù gōngyuán sànsanbù, chuīchuifēng.
examples.english: On summer evenings, I like to go to the park for a walk and to enjoy the breeze.

examples.chinese: 他吹笛子吹得很好，辦過幾場很成功的音樂表演。
examples.pinyin: Tā chuī dízi chuī de hěn hǎo, bànguò jǐ chǎng hěn chénggōng de yīnyuè biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: He plays the flute very well and has held several very successful music performances.

examples.chinese: 這個地區被颱風破壞得相當嚴重，不是樹木倒了，就是屋頂被吹走了，情況非常糟糕。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū bèi táifēng pòhuài de xiāngdāng yánzhòng, bùshì shùmù dǎo le, jiùshì wūdǐng bèi chuī zǒu le, qíngkuàng fēicháng zāogāo.
examples.english: This area was damaged quite severely by the typhoon; either trees fell down or roofs were blown away—the situation is very bad.

examples.chinese: 夏天的夜晚，人們喜歡在屋子外面吹著風、喝著茶，聊聊有趣的事。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de yèwǎn, rénmen xǐhuān zài wūzi wàimiàn chuī zhe fēng, hē zhe chá, liáoliao yǒuqù de shì.
examples.english: On summer nights, people like to be outside the house, feeling the breeze, drinking tea, and chatting about interesting things.

examples.chinese: 爺爺很喜歡在海邊釣魚，看著風景、吹著海風，他覺得舒服極了。
examples.pinyin: Yéye hěn xǐhuān zài hǎibiān diào yú, kàn zhe fēngjǐng, chuī zhe hǎifēng, tā juéde shūfu jí le.
examples.english: Grandpa really likes fishing by the sea; looking at the scenery and feeling the sea breeze, he feels extremely comfortable.

examples.chinese: 夏天的夜晚，在院子裡吹著涼快的風，欣賞天空美麗的星星， 簡直就像在天堂一樣。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de yèwǎn, zài yuànzi lǐ chuīzhe liángkuai de fēng, xīnshǎng tiānkōng měilì de xīngxing, jiǎnzhí jiù xiàng zài tiāntáng yīyàng.
examples.english: On a summer night, feeling the cool breeze in the yard and enjoying the beautiful stars in the sky, it's virtually like being in heaven.

examples.chinese: 上週末我們去爬山，走到半路時忽然吹起大風來，害我們不得不下山。
examples.pinyin: Shàng zhōumò wǒmen qù páshān, zǒu dào bànlù shí hūrán chuī qǐ dàfēng lái, hài wǒmen bùdébù xiàshān.
examples.english: Last weekend we went mountain climbing, and when we had walked halfway, suddenly a strong wind started blowing, which forced us to have to go down the mountain.

examples.chinese: 冷氣機裡的網子要常拆下來洗，不然可能吹出髒空氣。
examples.pinyin: Lěngqì jī lǐ de wǎngzi yào cháng chāi xiàlái xǐ, bùrán kěnéng chuī chū zāng kōngqì.
examples.english: The filter net in the air conditioner should often be taken apart and washed, otherwise it might blow out dirty air.

examples.chinese: 颱風過後，很多電線被強風吹壞了，需要幾天才能恢復正常。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng guò hòu, hěn duō diànxiàn bèi qiángfēng chuī huài le, xūyào jǐ tiān cái néng huīfù zhèngcháng.
examples.english: After the typhoon, many power lines were damaged by strong winds and will need several days to return to normal.

examples.chinese: 那家商店的廣告牌子被一陣強風吹起後，還差一點打到路上的摩托車，真可怕。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā shāngdiàn de guǎnggào páizi bèi yī zhèn qiángfēng chuī qǐ hòu, hái chà yīdiǎn dǎ dào lùshàng de mótuōchē, zhēn kěpà.
examples.english: After that shop's advertising sign was blown up by a gust of strong wind, it almost hit a motorcycle on the road; it was really scary.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳最辣的牛肉麵， 小程挑戰過好幾次，可惜都沒吃完。寫劇本對我來說是個很大的挑戰，但是也能得到不少收穫，所以我願意試試。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng zuì là de niúròumiàn, Xiǎo Chéng tiǎozhàn guò hǎo jǐ cì, kěxī dōu méi chī wán. Xiě jùběn duì wǒ lái shuō shì ge hěn dà de tiǎozhàn, dànshì yě néng dédào bùshǎo shōuhuò, suǒyǐ wǒ yuànyì shìshi.
examples.english: Xiao Cheng has challenged the spiciest beef noodles at this restaurant several times, but unfortunately he never finished them. Writing scripts is a big challenge for me, but I can also gain a lot from it, so I am willing to give it a try.

examples.chinese: 大偉挺喜歡他現在的工作，不但能挑戰自己，也能學習新的東西。
examples.pinyin: Dàwěi tǐng xǐhuān tā xiànzài de gōngzuò, bùdàn néng tiǎozhàn zìjǐ, yě néng xuéxí xīn de dōngxi.
examples.english: Dawei quite likes his current job; not only can it challenge him, but he can also learn new things.

examples.chinese: 舅舅對我很好，不管我遇到什麼挑戰，只要跟他說一聲，他一定會幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Jiùjiu duì wǒ hěn hǎo, bùguǎn wǒ yùdào shénme tiǎozhàn, zhǐyào gēn tā shuō yì shēng, tā yídìng huì bāngmáng.
examples.english: My uncle is very good to me; no matter what challenges I encounter, as long as I give him a mention, he will definitely help.

examples.chinese: 每個人都有夢想，只要不怕挑戰、堅持到底，就能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu mèngxiǎng, zhǐyào bú pà tiǎozhàn, jiānchí dàodǐ, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn.
examples.english: Everyone has dreams; as long as you are not afraid of challenges and persist to the end, your dreams can come true.

examples.chinese: 他願意挑戰自己的工作能力，並積極地克服挫折，真是難得。
examples.pinyin: Tā yuànyì tiǎozhàn zìjǐ de gōngzuò nénglì, bìng jījí de kèfú cuòzhé, zhēn shì nándé.
examples.english: He is willing to challenge his own work abilities and actively overcome setbacks; that is truly rare.

examples.chinese: 對自己的事業很熱情的人，就不怕挑戰任何困難。
examples.pinyin: Duì zìjǐ de shìyè hěn rèqíng de rén, jiù bù pà tiǎozhàn rènhé kùnnán.
examples.english: People who are very passionate about their careers are not afraid to challenge any difficulties.

examples.chinese: 當你面臨困難或挑戰時，也正是表現個人智慧與能力的最佳時刻。
examples.pinyin: Dāng nǐ miànlín kùnnán huò tiǎozhàn shí, yě zhèng shì biǎoxiàn gèrén zhìhuì yǔ nénglì de zuì jiā shíkè.
examples.english: When you face difficulties or challenges, it is also exactly the best moment to demonstrate personal wisdom and ability.

examples.chinese: 只有勇敢面對挑戰、克服困難的人，才能深深體會到成就感帶來的快樂。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu yǒnggǎn miànduì tiǎozhàn, kèfú kùnnán de rén, cái néng shēnshēn tǐhuì dào chéngjiùgǎn dàilái de kuàilè.
examples.english: Only those who bravely face challenges and overcome difficulties can deeply experience the happiness that a sense of accomplishment brings.

examples.chinese: 樂觀的人會積極挑戰困難，就算無法成功也不會感到失望。
examples.pinyin: Lèguān de rén huì jījí tiǎozhàn kùnnán, jiùsuàn wúfǎ chénggōng yě bù huì gǎndào shīwàng.
examples.english: Optimistic people will actively challenge difficulties; even if they cannot succeed, they will not feel disappointed.

items.key: ["B3L01-2-22","梦想成真","夢想成真","梦想成真","Ph"]

examples.chinese: A:我希望將來能當一名很棒的導演。 B:我相信只要你不斷地努力，就能夢想成真的！
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ xīwàng jiānglái néng dāng yī míng hěn bàng de dǎoyǎn. B: Wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào nǐ bùduàn de nǔlì, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn de!
examples.english: A: I hope that in the future I can become a great director. B: I believe that as long as you keep working hard, your dreams will come true!

examples.chinese: 章先生一直想當律師，經過多年的努力，終於夢想成真了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng yìzhí xiǎng dāng lǜshī, jīngguò duō nián de nǔlì, zhōngyú mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn le.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang has always wanted to be a lawyer. After years of effort, his dream has finally come true.

examples.chinese: 我一直想到歐洲去旅行，只是現在忙得沒時間去，希望明年能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yìzhí xiǎng dào Ōuzhōu qù lǚxíng, zhǐshì xiànzài máng de méi shíjiān qù, xīwàng míngnián néng mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn.
examples.english: I have always wanted to travel to Europe, but I am so busy now that I have no time to go. I hope my dream can come true next year.

examples.chinese: 小在追求夢想的路上，別太在意別人說什麼，只要不斷地努力，就能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zài zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshàng, bié tài zàiyì biérén shuō shénme, zhǐyào búduàn de nǔlì, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn.
examples.english: On the road of pursuing your dreams, don't care too much about what others say; as long as you keep working hard, your dreams can come true.

examples.chinese: 林小姐從小就希望有一家屬於自己的麵包店，今年終於夢想成真了。
examples.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě cóngxiǎo jiù xīwàng yǒu yī jiā shǔyú zìjǐ de miànbāodiàn, jīnnián zhōngyú mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn le.
examples.english: Miss Lin has hoped since childhood to have a bakery that belongs to herself; this year her dream has finally come true.

examples.chinese: 每個人都有夢想，只要不怕挑戰、堅持到底，就能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu mèngxiǎng, zhǐyào bú pà tiǎozhàn, jiānchí dàodǐ, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn.
examples.english: Everyone has dreams; as long as you are not afraid of challenges and persist to the end, your dreams can come true.

examples.chinese: 為了避免皮膚受傷，夏天出門時別忘了戴上帽子和太陽眼鏡。
examples.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn pífū shòushāng, xiàtiān chūmén shí bié wàng le dài shàng màozi hé tàiyáng yǎnjìng.
examples.english: To avoid skin injury, don't forget to put on a hat and sunglasses when going out in summer.

examples.chinese: 地震時要保護自己的安全，最重要的是避免頭部受傷。當地震發生時，我們應該怎麼做呢？
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn shí yào bǎohù zìjǐ de ānquán, zuì zhòngyào de shì bìmiǎn tóubù shòushāng. Dāng dìzhèn fāshēng shí, wǒmen yīnggāi zěnme zuò ne?
examples.english: During an earthquake, you must protect your own safety; the most important thing is to avoid head injury. When an earthquake occurs, what should we do?

examples.chinese: 前面發生了交通意外，為了避免被困在路上，我們還是走別條路吧。
examples.pinyin: Qiánmiàn fāshēng le jiāotōng yìwài, wèile bìmiǎn bèi kùn zài lùshàng, wǒmen háishì zǒu bié tiáo lù ba.
examples.english: There was a traffic accident ahead; to avoid being stuck on the road, we should take another route.

examples.chinese: 這條馬路高低不平，為了避免發生意外，開車經過時一定要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo mǎlù gāodī bù píng, wèile bìmiǎn fāshēng yìwài, kāichē jīngguò shí yīdìng yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: This road is uneven (high and low, not flat); in order to avoid accidents, you must be careful when driving through.

examples.chinese: 為了避免兒童發生意外，家長在樓梯邊裝了安全網。
examples.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn értóng fāshēng yìwài, jiāzhǎng zài lóutī biān zhuāng le ānquán wǎng.
examples.english: To avoid accidents involving children, the parents installed a safety net beside the stairs.

examples.chinese: 由於每個人看事情的角度不同，所以得溝通才能避免誤會。那個模特兒個子高、長得美，從什麼角度拍都漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú měi gè rén kàn shìqíng de jiǎodù bùtóng, suǒyǐ děi gōutōng cái néng bìmiǎn wùhuì. Nàge mótè'ér gèzi gāo, zhǎng de měi, cóng shénme jiǎodù pāi dōu piàoliang.
examples.english: Because each person's point of view on things is different, communication is necessary to avoid misunderstandings. That model is tall and beautiful; from whatever angle you photograph her, she looks pretty.

examples.chinese: 爬山時如果碰到大雨就應避免繼續前進，以免發生危險。
examples.pinyin: Páshān shí rúguǒ pèngdào dàyǔ jiù yīng bìmiǎn jìxù qiánjìn, yǐmiǎn fāshēng wēixiǎn.
examples.english: When mountain climbing, if you encounter heavy rain, you should avoid continuing to advance, so as to prevent danger from occurring.

examples.chinese: 每個人都得經驗老病死，這些都是自然發生，避免不了的。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu děi jīngyàn lǎo bìng sǐ, zhèxiē dōu shì zìrán fāshēng, bìmiǎn bù liǎo de.
examples.english: Everyone must experience aging, illness, and death; these happen naturally and cannot be avoided.

examples.chinese: 當別人遇到不愉快的事時，應該避免說些刺激他的話。
examples.pinyin: Dāng biérén yùdào bù yúkuài de shì shí, yīnggāi bìmiǎn shuō xiē cìjī tā de huà.
examples.english: When others encounter unpleasant things, one should avoid saying things that irritate them.

examples.chinese: 跑步比賽的起點跟終點之間都有人協助，避免參加比賽的人發生狀況。
examples.pinyin: Pǎobù bǐsài de qǐdiǎn gēn zhōngdiǎn zhījiān dōu yǒu rén xiézhù, bìmiǎn cānjiā bǐsài de rén fāshēng zhuàngkuàng.
examples.english: Between the starting point and the finishing line of the running race, there are people assisting to prevent situations from happening to the participants.

examples.chinese: 想有效解決身材肥胖的問題，就應避免吃太肥的肉、太油的菜，同時還得多運動。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yǒuxiào jiějué shēncái féipàng de wèntí, jiù yīng bìmiǎn chī tài féi de ròu, tài yóu de cài, tóngshí hái děi duō yùndòng.
examples.english: If you want to effectively solve the problem of being obese, you should avoid eating meat that is too fatty and dishes that are too oily, and at the same time you also need to exercise more.

examples.chinese: 她的物品上都有個小小的蝴蝶標誌，避免別人拿錯。
examples.pinyin: Tā de wùpǐn shàng dōu yǒu ge xiǎoxiǎo de húdié biāozhì, bìmiǎn biérén ná cuò.
examples.english: All her items have a small butterfly mark on them, to avoid others taking them by mistake.

items.wordHook: Combining 避(avoid) and 免(spare): 避免 means avoid.

examples.chinese: 出國留學有不少好處，例如打開視野、增加自信、提高外文程度等等。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó liúxué yǒu bùshǎo hǎochù, lìrú dǎkāi shìyě, zēngjiā zìxìn, tígāo wàiwén chéngdù děngděng.
examples.english: Studying abroad has many benefits, for example, broadening one's horizons, increasing self-confidence, improving foreign language proficiency, and so on.

examples.chinese: 顏小姐的職場表現很優秀，除了外文能力好，做事也很細心。
examples.pinyin: Yán xiǎojiě de zhíchǎng biǎoxiàn hěn yōuxiù, chúle wàiwén nénglì hǎo, zuòshì yě hěn xìxīn.
examples.english: Ms. Yan's performance in the workplace is outstanding; besides having good foreign language skills, she is also very careful in her work.

examples.chinese: 康小姐的工作能力很強，能一面掌握會議的重點，一面把會議內容翻譯成外文。
examples.pinyin: Kāng xiǎojiě de gōngzuò nénglì hěn qiáng, néng yīmiàn zhǎngwò huìyì de zhòngdiǎn, yīmiàn bǎ huìyì nèiróng fānyì chéng wàiwén.
examples.english: Miss Kang's work ability is very strong; she can simultaneously grasp the key points of a meeting and translate the meeting content into a foreign language.

items.wordHook: Combining 外(out) and 文(culture): 外文 means foreign language.

examples.chinese: 現代各式各樣的科技產品，讓人們的生活更舒適、便利。這家旅館每個房間都設計得很現代，吸引不少年輕人來訂房。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài gè shì gè yàng de kējì chǎnpǐn, ràng rénmen de shēnghuó gèng shūshì, biànlì. Zhè jiā lǚguǎn měi gè fángjiān dōu shèjì de hěn xiàndài, xīyǐn bù shǎo niánqīngrén lái dìng fáng.
examples.english: Modern various technological products make people's lives more comfortable and convenient. This hotel's rooms are all designed in a very modern way, attracting many young people to book rooms.

examples.chinese: 現代人往往以網路傳訊息，代替傳統寫信或打電話的方式。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài rén wǎngwǎng yǐ wǎnglù chuán xiāoxi, dàitì chuántǒng xiě xìn huò dǎ diànhuà de fāngshì.
examples.english: Modern people often use the internet to send messages, replacing the traditional ways of writing letters or making phone calls.

examples.chinese: 現代企業越來越重視員工的福利和健康，例如提供免費的旅遊和健檢。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài qǐyè yuèláiyuè zhòngshì yuángōng de fúlì hé jiànkāng, lìrú tígōng miǎnfèi de lǚyóu hé jiànjiǎn.
examples.english: Modern enterprises increasingly value employee benefits and health, for example, providing free travel and health checkups.

examples.chinese: 對現代人來說，電腦和網路絕對是辦公室的主要設備。
examples.pinyin: Duì xiàndài rén lái shuō, diànnǎo hé wǎnglù juéduì shì bàngōngshì de zhǔyào shèbèi.
examples.english: For modern people, computers and the internet are definitely the main equipment in the office.

examples.chinese: 做好環境保護的工作，是每個現代人應盡的責任。
examples.pinyin: Zuò hǎo huánjìng bǎohù de gōngzuò, shì měi ge xiàndài rén yīng jìn de zérèn.
examples.english: Doing a good job in environmental protection is the responsibility that every modern person should fulfill.

examples.chinese: 不少博物館裡的藝術品都是從古代保留到現代的，具有重要的時代意義。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo bówùguǎn lǐ de yìshùpǐn dōu shì cóng gǔdài bǎoliú dào xiàndài de, jùyǒu zhòngyào de shídài yìyì.
examples.english: Many artworks in museums have been preserved from ancient times to the present and have important historical significance.

examples.chinese: 現代社會資訊很發達，一發生重要事情，立刻就上電視、上報了。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài shèhuì zīxùn hěn fādá, yī fāshēng zhòngyào shìqíng, lìkè jiù shàng diànshì, shàng bào le.
examples.english: In modern society, information is very developed; as soon as an important event happens, it immediately appears on TV and in the newspapers.

examples.chinese: 現代的口紅不僅使用方便，在顏色上也有不少變化。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài de kǒuhóng bùjǐn shǐyòng fāngbiàn, zài yánsè shàng yě yǒu bùshǎo biànhuà.
examples.english: Modern lipstick is not only convenient to use, but also has quite a few variations in color.

examples.chinese: 由於網路發達，現代人大都習慣上網購物。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú wǎnglù fādá, xiàndài rén dàdōu xíguàn shàngwǎng gòuwù.
examples.english: Due to the development of the Internet, modern people for the most part are accustomed to shopping online.

examples.chinese: 他透過古典文學來討論古代與現代的文化差異。
examples.pinyin: Tā tòuguò gǔdiǎn wénxué lái tǎolùn gǔdài yǔ xiàndài de wénhuà chāyì.
examples.english: He discusses the cultural differences between ancient and modern times through classical literature.

examples.chinese: 現代人生活忙碌，就算是好友也偶然才碰面聊聊。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài rén shēnghuó mánglù, jiùsuàn shì hǎoyǒu yě ǒurán cái pèngmiàn liáoliao.
examples.english: Modern people are busy with life; even good friends only meet occasionally to chat.

examples.chinese: 商先生從不發脾氣，人也很謙虛，不論別人怎麼批評他，他還是很客氣地說謝謝。
examples.pinyin: Shāng xiānshēng cóng bù fā píqi, rén yě hěn qiānxū, bùlùn biérén zěnme pīpíng tā, tā háishi hěn kèqi de shuō xièxie.
examples.english: Mr. Shang never loses his temper and is also very modest; no matter how others criticize him, he still politely says thank you.

examples.chinese: 不論是工業或家庭廢水，對人們的健康都有不好的影響。
examples.pinyin: Bùlùn shì gōngyè huò jiātíng fèishuǐ, duì rénmen de jiànkāng dōu yǒu bù hǎo de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Whether industrial or household waste water, it all has a bad impact on people's health.

examples.chinese: 他一直熱愛翻譯工作，不論多困難都會想辦法克服。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīzhí rè'ài fānyì gōngzuò, bùlùn duō kùnnan dōu huì xiǎng bànfǎ kèfú.
examples.english: He has always been passionate about translation work; no matter how difficult it is, he will find a way to overcome it.

examples.chinese: 阿溫對花草很有興趣，不論生長在平原或山地的，他都叫得出名字來。
examples.pinyin: Ā Wēn duì huācǎo hěn yǒu xìngqù, bùlùn shēngzhǎng zài píngyuán huò shāndì de, tā dōu jiàodechū míngzi lái.
examples.english: A-Wen is very interested in flowers and plants; no matter whether they grow on plains or in mountains, he can name them all.

examples.chinese: 喜劇中的男女主角，不論相處過程中碰到多少挫折，結局總是快樂又幸福的。
examples.pinyin: Xǐjù zhōng de nánnǚ zhǔjiǎo, búlùn xiāngchǔ guòchéng zhōng pèngdào duōshǎo cuòzhé, jiéjú zǒngshì kuàilè yòu xìngfú de.
examples.english: In comedies, no matter how many setbacks the male and female leads encounter during their time together, the ending is always happy and blissful.

examples.chinese: 父母要求孩子不論在任何情況都不許騙人。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ yāoqiú háizi bùlùn zài rènhé qíngkuàng dōu bùxǔ piàn rén.
examples.english: Parents require that their children must not lie under any circumstances.

examples.chinese: 我們全家都是信基督教的，不論教會舉辦什麼活動，我們都一定去參加。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen quánjiā dōu shì xìn Jīdūjiào de, bùlùn jiàohuì jǔbàn shénme huódòng, wǒmen dōu yīdìng qù cānjiā.
examples.english: Our whole family is Christian; no matter what activities the church holds, we always go to participate.

items.wordHook: Clearly 不(not) possessing 論(debate): 不論 means no matter what, who, how.

examples.chinese: 哥哥去超市買了一袋玉米和兩包麵條，要為家人準備晚餐。
examples.pinyin: Gēge qù chāoshì mǎi le yí dài yùmǐ hé liǎng bāo miàntiáo, yào wèi jiārén zhǔnbèi wǎncān.
examples.english: My older brother went to the supermarket and bought a bag of corn and two packs of noodles, to prepare dinner for the family.

examples.chinese: 小孩子剛學習用筷子吃麵條時，常需要媽媽先替他把麵拌一拌。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoháizi gāng xuéxí yòng kuàizi chī miàntiáo shí, cháng xūyào māma xiān tì tā bǎ miàn bàn yī bàn.
examples.english: When little children first learn to eat noodles with chopsticks, they often need their mother to first mix the noodles for them.

examples.chinese: 上帝是不是存在，這是屬於宗教領域的問題，科學家的解釋不一定是正確的。
examples.pinyin: Shàngdì shì bú shì cúnzài, zhè shì shǔyú zōngjiào lǐngyù de wèntí, kēxuéjiā de jiěshì bù yídìng shì zhèngquè de.
examples.english: Whether God exists or not is a question that belongs to the religious field; scientists' explanations are not necessarily correct.

examples.chinese: 要是你對文藝領域不了解，最好不要隨便批評別人的作品。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ duì wényì lǐngyù bù liǎojiě, zuìhǎo bùyào suíbiàn pīpíng biérén de zuòpǐn.
examples.english: If you don't understand the field of literature and art, you'd better not casually criticize others' works.

examples.chinese: 這次座談會邀請了各領域的人們，主要目的是對國內的地方建設提一些建議。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì zuòtánhuì yāoqǐng le gè lǐngyù de rénmen, zhǔyào mùdì shì duì guónèi de dìfāng jiànshè tí yìxiē jiànyì.
examples.english: This forum invited people from various fields; its main purpose is to offer some suggestions for domestic local construction.

examples.chinese: 她的專業是人工智慧，這個領域的問題可以請教她。
examples.pinyin: Tā de zhuānyè shì réngōng zhìhuì, zhège lǐngyù de wèntí kěyǐ qǐngjiào tā.
examples.english: Her specialty is artificial intelligence; you can ask her about problems in this field.

items.wordHook: Combining 領(withdraw money) and 域(area): 領域 means field.

examples.chinese: 科學家早就證明了氣溫的變化對農業生產有不好的影響，可是到目前還找不到解決的好辦法。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zǎo jiù zhèngmíng le qìwēn de biànhuà duì nóngyè shēngchǎn yǒu bù hǎo de yǐngxiǎng, kěshì dào mùqián hái zhǎo bú dào jiějué de hǎo bànfǎ.
examples.english: Scientists proved long ago that temperature changes have a bad effect on agricultural production, but up to now they still cannot find a good solution.

examples.chinese: 連警察都證明這個車禍是段老闆喝醉造成的，可是他仍然不肯承認。
examples.pinyin: Lián jǐngchá dōu zhèngmíng zhège chēhuò shì Duàn lǎobǎn hē zuì zàochéng de, kěshì tā réngrán bù kěn chéngrèn.
examples.english: Even the police proved that this car accident was caused by Boss Duan getting drunk, but he still refuses to admit it.

examples.chinese: 身分證是用來證明一個人的身分時使用的。
examples.pinyin: Shēnfènzhèng shì yòng lái zhèngmíng yī ge rén de shēnfèn shí shǐyòng de.
examples.english: An identity card is used when proving a person's identity.

examples.chinese: 華語中心的學生想在臺灣的銀行開戶，得先準備在學證明。
examples.pinyin: Huáyǔ zhōngxīn de xuésheng xiǎng zài Táiwān de yínháng kāihù, děi xiān zhǔnbèi zàixué zhèngmíng.
examples.english: Students at the Mandarin Training Center who want to open an account at a bank in Taiwan must first prepare a certificate of enrollment.

items.wordHook: Combining 證(prove) and 明(bright): 證明 means prove.

examples.chinese: 我夢想有一天可以到世界各地旅行。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèngxiǎng yǒu yìtiān kěyǐ dào shìjiè gèdì lǚxíng.
examples.english: I dream of one day being able to travel to all parts of the world.

examples.chinese: 每天光說夢想，一點兒用都沒有，還是努力實現比較實在。
examples.pinyin: Měitiān guāng shuō mèngxiǎng, yìdiǎnr yòng dōu méiyǒu, háishì nǔlì shíxiàn bǐjiào shízài.
examples.english: Just talking about dreams every day is of no use at all; it's more practical to work hard to achieve them.

examples.chinese: 他的夢想是利用水來當作交通工具的燃料，可是很多人認為不可能。
examples.pinyin: Tā de mèngxiǎng shì lìyòng shuǐ lái dāngzuò jiāotōng gōngjù de ránliào, kěshì hěn duō rén rènwéi bù kěnéng.
examples.english: His dream is to use water as fuel for transportation vehicles, but many people think it is impossible.

examples.chinese: 我心中有兩個夢想，一是當歌星，另一個是去各國旅行。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xīn zhōng yǒu liǎng ge mèngxiǎng, yī shì dāng gēxīng, lìng yí ge shì qù gè guó lǚxíng.
examples.english: I have two dreams in my heart: one is to become a singer, and the other is to travel to various countries.

examples.chinese: 小年的夢想就是蓋一棟土地面積六十坪、三層樓高的房子，讓全家人都住在一起。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎonián de mèngxiǎng jiùshì gài yí dòng tǔdì miànjī liùshí píng, sān céng lóu gāo de fángzi, ràng quánjiā rén dōu zhù zài yìqǐ.
examples.english: Xiao Nian's dream is to build a three-story house with a land area of sixty ping, so that the whole family can live together.

examples.chinese: 易先生對戲劇有很大的興趣，小時候的夢想就是當一名成功的演員。
examples.pinyin: Yì xiānsheng duì xìjù yǒu hěn dà de xìngqù, xiǎoshíhou de mèngxiǎng jiùshì dāng yì míng chénggōng de yǎnyuán.
examples.english: Mr. Yi has a great interest in drama; his childhood dream was to become a successful actor.

examples.chinese: 每個人都有夢想，只要不怕挑戰、堅持到底，就能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu mèngxiǎng, zhǐyào bú pà tiǎozhàn, jiānchí dàodǐ, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn.
examples.english: Everyone has dreams; as long as you are not afraid of challenges and persist to the end, your dreams can come true.

examples.chinese: 林小姐從小就希望有一家屬於自己的麵包店，今年終於夢想成真了。
examples.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě cóngxiǎo jiù xīwàng yǒu yī jiā shǔyú zìjǐ de miànbāodiàn, jīnnián zhōngyú mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn le.
examples.english: Miss Lin has hoped since childhood to have a bakery that belongs to herself; this year her dream has finally come true.

examples.chinese: 小在追求夢想的路上，別太在意別人說什麼，只要不斷地努力，就能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zài zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshàng, bié tài zàiyì biérén shuō shénme, zhǐyào búduàn de nǔlì, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn.
examples.english: On the road of pursuing your dreams, don't care too much about what others say; as long as you keep working hard, your dreams can come true.

examples.chinese: 不管追求夢想的路上有多辛苦，都是我們一輩子珍貴的回憶。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshang yǒu duō xīnkǔ, dōu shì wǒmen yībèizi zhēnguì de huíyì.
examples.english: No matter how hard the road of pursuing dreams is, it is all precious memories for a lifetime.

examples.chinese: 我一直想到歐洲去旅行，只是現在忙得沒時間去，希望明年能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yìzhí xiǎng dào Ōuzhōu qù lǚxíng, zhǐshì xiànzài máng de méi shíjiān qù, xīwàng míngnián néng mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn.
examples.english: I have always wanted to travel to Europe, but I am so busy now that I have no time to go. I hope my dream can come true next year.

examples.chinese: 章先生一直想當律師，經過多年的努力，終於夢想成真了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng yìzhí xiǎng dāng lǜshī, jīngguò duō nián de nǔlì, zhōngyú mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn le.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang has always wanted to be a lawyer. After years of effort, his dream has finally come true.

examples.chinese: 小韓早晚都打工，是因為想多存一些錢，早一點完成出國念書的夢想。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hán zǎowǎn dōu dǎgōng, shì yīnwèi xiǎng duō cún yìxiē qián, zǎo yìdiǎn wánchéng chūguó niànshū de mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: Xiao Han works part-time in the morning and evening because he wants to save more money and fulfill his dream of studying abroad earlier.

examples.chinese: A:我希望將來能當一名很棒的導演。 B:我相信只要你不斷地努力，就能夢想成真的！
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ xīwàng jiānglái néng dāng yī míng hěn bàng de dǎoyǎn. B: Wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào nǐ bùduàn de nǔlì, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn de!
examples.english: A: I hope that in the future I can become a great director. B: I believe that as long as you keep working hard, your dreams will come true!

examples.chinese: 在追求夢想的路上，會遇到很困難的事情，只有不斷努力，才能完成夢想。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshang, huì yùdào hěn kùnnan de shìqing, zhǐyǒu bùduàn nǔlì, cái néng wánchéng mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: On the road of pursuing your dreams, you will encounter very difficult things; only by making continuous efforts can you fulfill your dreams.

examples.chinese: 小鐘昨天晚上做了好幾個夢，沒睡好，難怪今天精神很不好。有人說，有夢最美。應該趁著年輕勇敢地做夢，更要努力讓夢想變成真的。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōng zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le hǎo jǐ ge mèng, méi shuì hǎo, nánguài jīntiān jīngshén hěn bù hǎo. Yǒu rén shuō, yǒu mèng zuì měi. Yīnggāi chènzhe niánqīng yǒnggǎn de zuòmèng, gèng yào nǔlì ràng mèngxiǎng biànchéng zhēn de.
examples.english: Xiao Zhong had several dreams last night and didn't sleep well; no wonder he is in very low spirits today. Some people say that having dreams is the most beautiful thing. You should bravely dream while you are young, and even more, work hard to make your dreams come true.

examples.chinese: 美美最大的夢想是，將來能有一棟又漂亮又舒服的大房子。
examples.pinyin: Měiměi zuìdà de mèngxiǎng shì, jiānglái néng yǒu yī dòng yòu piàoliang yòu shūfu de dà fángzi.
examples.english: Meimei's biggest dream is that in the future she can have a big house that is both beautiful and comfortable.

examples.chinese: A:你說自己沒有想做的事，難道你沒有夢想嗎？ B:我只想簡單過生活，再說，沒有夢想難道不行嗎？
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ shuō zìjǐ méiyǒu xiǎng zuò de shì, nándào nǐ méiyǒu mèngxiǎng ma? B: Wǒ zhǐ xiǎng jiǎndān guò shēnghuó, zàishuō, méiyǒu mèngxiǎng nándào bùxíng ma?
examples.english: A: You say you have nothing you want to do—don't you have dreams? B: I just want to live a simple life; besides, is it not okay to have no dreams?

examples.chinese: 我愛看漫畫，在漫畫裡可以看見許多人們還沒實現的夢想。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ ài kàn mànhuà, zài mànhuà lǐ kěyǐ kànjiàn xǔduō rénmen hái méi shíxiàn de mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: I love reading comics; in comics, you can see many dreams that people have not yet realized.

examples.chinese: 擁有一架小飛機並親自在天空上駕駛，一直是孫小姐的夢想。
examples.pinyin: Yōngyǒu yí jià xiǎo fēijī bìng qīnzì zài tiānkōng shàng jiàshǐ, yìzhí shì Sūn xiǎojiě de mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: Owning a small airplane and piloting it in the sky oneself has always been Miss Sun's dream.

examples.chinese: 雖然受到了重大的挫折，可是他並沒有放棄自己的夢想。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán shòudào le zhòngdà de cuòzhé, kěshì tā bìng méiyǒu fàngqì zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: Although he suffered a major setback, he actually did not give up his dream.

examples.chinese: 阿溫對花草很有興趣，不論生長在平原或山地的，他都叫得出名字來。
examples.pinyin: Ā Wēn duì huācǎo hěn yǒu xìngqù, bùlùn shēngzhǎng zài píngyuán huò shāndì de, tā dōu jiàodechū míngzi lái.
examples.english: A-Wen is very interested in flowers and plants; no matter whether they grow on plains or in mountains, he can name them all.

examples.chinese: 今天光是整理前院的花草樹木就讓我累得要命，只好明天再整理後院了。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān guāng shì zhěnglǐ qiányuàn de huācǎo shùmù jiù ràng wǒ lèi de yàomìng, zhǐhǎo míngtiān zài zhěnglǐ hòuyuàn le.
examples.english: Today, just tidying up the flowers, plants, and trees in the front yard made me extremely tired, so I'll have to do the backyard tomorrow.

examples.chinese: A:你要不要跟我一起去茶館喝杯茶？ B:與其去喝茶，我倒想去外面走走，看看花草樹木。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ yào bù yào gēn wǒ yīqǐ qù cháguǎn hē bēi chá? B: Yǔqí qù hē chá, wǒ dào xiǎng qù wàimiàn zǒuzǒu, kànkan huā cǎo shùmù.
examples.english: A: Do you want to go to the teahouse with me to have a cup of tea? B: Rather than go drink tea, I'd actually like to go for a walk outside and look at the flowers, grass, and trees.

examples.chinese: 要想成為成功的上班族，一切就得照規矩來。
examples.pinyin: Yào xiǎng chéngwéi chénggōng de shàngbānzú, yīqiè jiù děi zhào guīju lái.
examples.english: If you want to become a successful office worker, everything must be done according to the rules.

examples.chinese: 這家醫院的內科有最新設備，因此成為許多病人的第一選擇。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn de nèikē yǒu zuìxīn shèbèi, yīncǐ chéngwéi xǔduō bìngrén de dì yī xuǎnzé.
examples.english: This hospital's internal medicine department has the latest equipment, so it has become the first choice for many patients.

examples.chinese: 他想成為網路作家，不過擔心將來的收入可能不穩定。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng chéngwéi wǎnglù zuòjiā, bùguò dānxīn jiānglái de shōurù kěnéng bù wěndìng.
examples.english: He wants to become an online writer, but worries that his future income may be unstable.

examples.chinese: 他對志工服務一向有興趣，哪怕做得又忙又累，他也願意。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì zhìgōng fúwù yīxiàng yǒu xìngqù, nǎpà zuò de yòu máng yòu lèi, tā yě yuànyì.
examples.english: He has always been interested in volunteer service; even if it is busy and tiring, he is willing to do it.

examples.chinese: 父母反對她從事電影行業，哪怕收入很高，還是不贊成。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ fǎnduì tā cóngshì diànyǐng hángyè, nǎpà shōurù hěn gāo, háishì bù zànchéng.
examples.english: Her parents oppose her working in the film industry; even if the income is high, they still do not approve.

examples.chinese: 老師提醒學生有疑問要馬上解決，免得越到後面越不了解。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī tíxǐng xuéshēng yǒu yíwèn yào mǎshàng jiějué, miǎnde yuè dào hòumiàn yuè bù liǎojiě.
examples.english: The teacher reminded the students that if they have any questions, they should resolve them immediately, lest the further they go, the less they understand.

examples.chinese: 傳說月亮上住著一隻兔子，這個神話留給孩子們許多想像空間。
examples.pinyin: Chuánshuō yuèliang shàng zhù zhe yī zhī tùzi, zhège shénhuà liú gěi háizimen xǔduō xiǎngxiàng kōngjiān.
examples.english: Legend has it that a rabbit lives on the moon; this myth leaves children a lot of room for imagination.

examples.chinese: 那棟沒有主人的房屋充滿恐怖的傳說，一般人都不願意靠近。
examples.pinyin: Nà dòng méiyǒu zhǔrén de fángwū chōngmǎn kǒngbù de chuánshuō, yībān rén dōu bù yuànyì kàojìn.
examples.english: That house without an owner is full of terrifying legends; ordinary people are all unwilling to go near it.

items.wordHook: The 朿(thorn) is the point; the 刂(knife) is the force that drives it in — 刺(stab).
Facing opposite across the table 對(correct) in the other party's 方(direction): 對方 means the other party, opponent.
a 尸(body) stretches out straight for measuring → 尺(ruler).
A steady 扌(hand) reaches across the royal 廷(courtyard) standing perfectly upright, looking 挺(very) proud.
Combining 救(aid) and 災(disaster): 救災 means provide disaster relief.
Combining 樣(form) and 式(formula): 樣式 means style.
The 二(two) top lines and 小(small) base form a stone altar → 示(altar).
Combining 結(knot) and 果(fruit): 結果 means as a result.
An empty clay 缶(jar) broken by a 夬(decisive) crack suffers a noticeable 缺(lack).
